# Frontend Instructions

- Read AGENTS.md first.
- Follow docs/ai/coding-standards.md for consistency and security.
- Keep UI changes accessible, responsive, and testable.
- Document architecture-impacting UI decisions in docs/architecture/decisions.
- Update relevant docs when introducing new frontend modules or workflows.
